description: Fix 5 (opening order) and fix 6 (guaranteed termination). The mandated first sentence is the first thing the agent says whatever the entry path (fixed tts when the spec has a template; model-composed first message with a directive when only must_include exists). Termination is state-driven: promise/note post-hooks set auto_close, the negotiate node transitions to finalize in the same turn, finalize picks a SPOKEN end_call node (confirmation sentence singular/plural + farewell); everything else goes through a 'wrapup' node with max_node_turns=2 (platform turn counter); every exit end_call node speaks the thanks and goodbye from the spec. Depends on FEAT-002 (promise hooks) and FEAT-003 (compiler/node_prompts edits done first). Last code FEAT; touches the graph so it must run after the others.
steps: 4.1 builder/node_prompts.py: opening_mode(spec) -> fixed|composed|question_only|none; opening_directive(spec) for 'composed' (first message = one sentence that says every must_include item, then in the same message the confirmation question, nothing before it, even if the customer speaks first); standing rule in _opening_lines ('the mandated first sentence always comes before any other utterance; answer a customer question only after it'; answer_question_first reads 'after the first sentence'). builder/compiler.py: on_enter tts for fixed/question_only (as today) and {'type':'llm'} for composed with the directive first in identity_task; warn for composed and warn when a template lacks a must_include item (case-insensitive). builder/selfcheck.py: new check opening.order (feature 'structure'). builder/extract_prompts/sections.md opening paragraph: template must contain every must_include item, composed from the documents' own words. Tests: tests/test_node_prompts.py, tests/test_compiler.py, tests/test_selfcheck.py (passes on fixtures; fails when the tts text is reordered).

4.2 builder/compiler.py termination per plan section 5 'Fix 6': farewell() (spec text -> DEFAULT_FAREWELL_EN 'Thank you, and goodbye.' only when meta.language starts with 'en' and goodbye is required but unworded, with a warning -> otherwise gap and silent), confirm_single()/confirm_plural() from promise_rules.success_sentence / success_sentence_plural (plural falls back to singular), auto_close and farewell_auto flags; spoken() always appends the farewell; silent model exits, the gated callback exit and the backend-failure end speak the farewell; end nodes end_final (farewell only), end_final_single, end_final_plural (created only when the sentence exists); finalize/finalize_forced/finalize_early transitions: closing_variant == plural -> end_final_plural, == single -> end_final_single, then closing_ready == yes -> end_final, then the existing fallbacks; negotiate transitions after the two failure groups: auto_close == yes -> finalize, closing_ready == yes -> wrapup, then the tool transitions kept as the model-led fallback; new NODE_WRAPUP ('wrapup', WRAPUP_TURNS = 2, conversation, on_enter llm, task from node_prompts.wrapup_task, tools = the transition_to_finalize transition, max_turn_transition = finalize); reach wrapup from identity only if it is a one-line change, else note it in TO_VERIFY. Update RESERVED_NODES, written_vars (auto_close, closing_variant) and TO_VERIFY (auto_close same-turn transition, spoken end_call, wrapup turn cap, bank rejection of blank amount/product id).

4.2b builder/hooks.py: promise_post_hook and note_post_hook accept cfg auto_close; _next_text sets vars['auto_close']='yes' when _all_handled() and AUTO_CLOSE and returns 'Everything is handled. Say nothing more: the confirmation and the goodbye are spoken automatically and the call ends.'; intermediate products no longer append the success sentence when auto_close; without auto_close the old text is kept; transfer_post_hook unchanged (goes through wrapup). finalize_source computes vars['closing_variant'] (single / plural / '' when a transfer is done or nothing recorded) from p<k>_promise == 'recorded' and transfer_state with cfg confirm_single/confirm_plural (default False). exit/callback hook texts take cfg farewell_auto to drop the 'say the goodbye text' clause (DEFAULT_TEXTS cb_done_exit).

4.2c builder/node_prompts.py: PromptCtx.farewell_auto and helper _close_with(spec, ctx, tool) replacing every `_say_goodbye(spec) + ' and call '` call site (_exit_line, _opening_lines, _third_party_lines x4, _identity_lines, render_actions transfer, _persuasion_lines, negotiate_task); when auto_close the negotiate finish sentence says the call ends by itself and tells the model not to say goodbye or the confirmation sentence; drop exactly the success_sentence / success_sentence_plural texts from the 'say word for word' mandated list of the negotiate node when auto_close is on; wrapup_task. builder/selfcheck.py checks closing.auto_close, closing.end_nodes_speak, closing.wrapup_cap (feature 'structure'). builder/lint.py needs no new rule beyond FEAT-003 (graph rule already requires every node to reach an end_call node). Update tests/test_compiler.py:243-246 (silent end node only when the spec has no farewell and language is not 'en').

4.3 Tests: tests/test_hooks.py (auto_close only when all handled, no success sentence on intermediate products, finalize closing_variant single/plural/transfer/none, farewell_auto texts), tests/test_compiler.py (transition order, wrapup node and caps, every end node spoken, three end variants, backend end speaks, silence rule), tests/test_node_prompts.py (no 'say goodbye' instruction when auto, present otherwise; mandated list excludes the confirmation sentences when auto), tests/test_selfcheck.py (new checks pass on fixtures, fail when the auto_close transition is removed or an end node is silent), tests/test_lint.py if the graph changes need it.
4.4 Dry CLI smoke on spec_brief_a and spec_brief_ab (plan section 7.5) and delete the two run dirs afterwards.
acceptance_criteria: For a spec with first_sentence.template the identity node's tts text starts with the first sentence and then the confirmation question; for a spec with only must_include the node opens with llm and its task starts with the directive; selfcheck opening.order passes on every fixture.

Every end_call node of a compiled fixture speaks the spec's farewell (or the documented default for 'en'); with a confirmation sentence the final end nodes speak confirmation + farewell (singular/plural by recorded promises).

After the last promise/note post-hook (all products handled) the hook sets auto_close='yes' and the compiled negotiate node leaves for finalize via a variable transition placed before the tool transitions; a wrapup node with max_node_turns=2 and max_turn_transition=finalize exists for non-auto closings.
No model prompt tells the model to say goodbye when the farewell is spoken automatically.
uv run pytest -q passes (>= 679, 0 failures); contamination script clean; dry CLI smokes show lint 0 errors and 0 failed selfchecks.
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_node_prompts.py tests/test_compiler.py tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_selfcheck.py tests/test_lint.py tests/test_pipeline_selfcheck.py
uv run python build.py briefs/brief-a.md --dry --spec tests/fixtures/spec_brief_a.json --slot offline-a
uv run python build.py briefs/brief-a.md briefs/brief-b.md --dry --spec tests/fixtures/spec_brief_ab.json --slot offline-ab
